zh.title: ChatGPT 随 GPT-6 推出 Intelligent UI
zh.summary: OpenAI 宣布让回答结合文字、图表、表单与可交互工具，并逐步向更多 ChatGPT 套餐开放。
zh.why: 生成式界面进入面向大众的对话产品，界面选择成为模型回答的一部分。
zh.details: 官方披露原生可流式组件库与增量编译器，使界面能够边生成边展示。训练评估关注清晰度、实用性与完整性。
zh.caveat: 公告针对 ChatGPT Chat；不意味着同日提供对应公开 API，也不代表 Work 或 Codex 同步更换模型。
zh.audience: 开发者、设计师与产品人员

en.title: ChatGPT introduces Intelligent UI with GPT-6
en.summary: OpenAI announced responses combining text, charts, forms and interactive tools, with a staged rollout across ChatGPT plans.
en.why: Interface selection becomes part of mainstream conversational responses.
en.details: Native streamable components and an incremental compiler support progressive rendering. Training evaluations consider clarity, usefulness and completeness.
en.caveat: This concerns ChatGPT Chat, not a confirmed public UI API or a simultaneous Work/Codex model change.

zh.title: OUI-1 发布：面向生成式界面的开放权重模型
zh.summary: Thesys 发布以 DiffusionGemma 微调的 OUI-1，生成 OpenUI Lang，并探索消费级设备上的本地界面生成。
zh.why: 专用模型为低延迟、靠近用户设备的生成式 UI 提供了另一条路线。
zh.details: 模型有 26B 总参数、4B 活跃参数。训练结合监督微调、解析器反馈修复与自蒸馏。
zh.caveat: 71.7% 是厂商自有评测结果，尚非独立复现；不采用其“世界第一”宣传。
zh.audience: 开发者与模型研究者

en.title: OUI-1 brings specialized open weights to UI generation
en.summary: Thesys released a DiffusionGemma fine-tune producing OpenUI Lang, targeting local interface generation.
en.why: Specialization offers another route toward responsive interfaces on consumer hardware.
en.details: The model has 26B total and 4B active parameters. Training combines supervision, parser-guided repair and self-distillation.
en.caveat: Its reported 71.7% score is first-party evidence, not independent replication or proof of a world-first claim.

zh.title: OpenUI 发布生成式界面可靠性比较方法
zh.summary: Thesys 比较 OpenUI、A2UI 与 json-render，分别观察结构有效性、能否显示内容及 token 消耗。
zh.why: 可渲染、结构正确和满足任务是不同验收层次，失败形态也影响用户体验。
zh.details: 方法采用 46 个提示、6 个模型与统一 70 组件目录，并重复生成。本文仅确认评测发布及方法，争议比较数字待核验。
zh.caveat: 组件目录源自 OpenUI；原文正文与表格存在数字及版本矛盾，不能据此确认通用排名。
zh.audience: 开发者与评测研究者

en.title: OpenUI publishes a reliability comparison methodology
en.summary: Thesys compared OpenUI, A2UI and json-render through structural validity, visible output and token use.
en.why: Rendering, structural correctness and task completion require separate checks.
en.details: The setup uses 46 prompts, six models and a shared 70-component catalog with repeated runs. This report covers the publication and method; disputed figures await verification.
en.caveat: The vendor-derived catalog and inconsistent figures/version labels prevent a general ranking.

zh.title: 历史里程碑：Gemini 引入按需生成的交互界面
zh.summary: Google 随 Gemini 3 宣布 visual layout 与 dynamic view 两种生成式界面实验。
zh.why: 同一问题能够选择不同的信息布局和交互方式，而非固定文字回答。
zh.details: visual layout 组合视觉模块。dynamic view 利用模型编码能力实时生成定制界面。
zh.caveat: 这是 2025 年历史补录；实验性分批推出公告不证明每位用户当前均能使用。
zh.audience: 开发者、设计师与产品人员

en.title: Milestone: Gemini introduces on-demand generative interfaces
en.summary: Google announced visual layout and dynamic view experiments alongside Gemini 3.
en.why: Responses can adapt both their layout and interaction to a question.
en.details: Visual layout assembles rich modules. Dynamic view generates a custom interface through coding.
en.caveat: This is a 2025 backfill; the experimental rollout does not establish universal current availability.

zh.title: Macaron-A2UI 探索个人智能体的专用界面模型
zh.summary: 研究将自然语言与轻量可执行 UI 动作结合，用于收集信息、调整偏好和确认操作。
zh.why: 生成式 UI 的训练目标扩展到用户决策与交互组织。
zh.details: 论文提出 A2UI-Bench。作者对多种规模模型实施 LoRA 监督微调及奖励驱动训练。
zh.caveat: 分数来自作者设计的评测；名称不应被误写为 Google A2UI 的官方模型。
zh.audience: 开发者与模型研究者

en.title: Macaron-A2UI explores specialized UI models for personal agents
en.summary: The paper combines natural language with executable UI actions for information gathering, preferences and confirmation.
en.why: Training targets interaction and user decisions as well as presentation.
en.details: It introduces A2UI-Bench. Models use LoRA supervision followed by reward-driven optimization.
en.caveat: Results use the authors’ benchmark; this is not established as Google’s official A2UI model.

zh.title: Design Theater 检查界面是否兑现设计解释
zh.summary: 研究评估生成式 UI 工具对设计选择的解释，与实际生成界面之间的落差。
zh.why: 可信的解释不能替代可操作界面与功能验收。
zh.details: 作者以 24 项任务评估 5 种工具生成的 120 个界面，覆盖结构、样式与功能要求。所读版本于 7 月 31 日修订。
zh.caveat: 结论受当时工具版本和任务集合限制，不是所有生成式 UI 系统的总体故障率。
zh.audience: 设计师、产品人员与研究者

en.title: Design Theater tests whether interfaces fulfill their explanations
en.summary: Researchers examined gaps between tools’ design rationales and implemented interfaces.
en.why: Persuasive explanations cannot substitute for behavioral verification.
en.details: The study evaluates 120 interfaces from five tools across 24 structural, styling and functional tasks. The consulted version was revised July 31.
en.caveat: Findings concern sampled versions and tasks, not a universal failure rate.

zh.title: EvoGenUI-Bench 将可靠性评测扩展到连续修改
zh.summary: 新评测考察用户需求连续变化时，生成式界面能否保持执行能力与状态一致。
zh.why: 单次成功截图无法证明第五轮修改后仍然可用。
zh.details: 150 个五轮任务覆盖信息呈现、交互和工具外部状态，结合浏览器执行、DOM、截图与日志取证。所读版本于 9 月 7 日修订。
zh.caveat: 论文报告的模型表现依赖此任务集；本站未独立复现其评分。
zh.audience: 开发者与评测研究者

en.title: EvoGenUI-Bench evaluates interfaces through repeated changes
en.summary: The benchmark tests executable interfaces as user requirements evolve across turns.
en.why: A successful screenshot cannot establish reliability after repeated edits.
en.details: It includes 150 five-turn tasks, using browser execution, DOM evidence, screenshots and runtime logs. The consulted version was revised September 7.
en.caveat: Reported model results are task-dependent and have not been independently reproduced here.

zh.title: GUIDE 让设计师持续校准生成式界面
zh.summary: GUIDE 研究如何通过设计师的检查与修改，使动态生成结果更符合设计意图和品牌要求。
zh.why: 动态界面无法逐页预先审核，设计约束需要进入持续生成流程。
zh.details: 系统结合提示优化、自适应一致性评分与设计师反馈。作者开展了 12 名 UI/UX 从业者参与的研究。
zh.caveat: 小规模研究提供可行性证据，不代表跨品牌或大规模上线已验证。
zh.audience: 设计师、产品人员与研究者

en.title: GUIDE lets designers refine generative UI behavior
en.summary: GUIDE studies how designer feedback can align generated interfaces with intent and brand requirements.
en.why: Dynamic screens require constraints that survive ongoing generation.
en.details: The system combines prompt optimization, adaptive conformance scoring and designer feedback. Evaluation included 12 UI/UX practitioners.
en.caveat: The small study supports feasibility, not broad deployment or cross-brand validation.

zh.title: 教育研究探索有教学约束的生成式交互模拟
zh.summary: 研究提出 learning interactives，借助 Gemini 构建定制学习模拟，并由教育工作者评估。
zh.why: 有交互并不自动产生学习效果，生成流程还需体现教学目标。
zh.details: 框架围绕教学原则组织模拟生成。评估包含教育工作者研究与专家教师评分。
zh.caveat: 这些评估不等同于已证明学生长期成绩提升，也不是独立产品全面上线公告。
zh.audience: 教育产品人员、设计师与研究者

en.title: Learning interactives adds pedagogical constraints to generated simulations
en.summary: Researchers used Gemini to produce tailored learning simulations evaluated by educators.
en.why: Interactivity alone does not establish educational effectiveness.
en.details: The framework structures generation around pedagogy. Evaluation combines educator studies with expert teacher ratings.
en.caveat: These evaluations do not establish long-term student gains or a general product launch.
en.audience: Education product teams, designers and researchers

zh.title: OpenUI 讨论将重复交互交给查询运行时
zh.summary: 技术文章展示模型生成界面规范后，由运行时处理筛选与查询，而非每次交互都重新调用模型。
zh.why: 生成意图与执行交互分离，有助于降低重复操作的延迟及上下文负担。
zh.details: OpenUI Lang 使用响应式变量和 Query 声明绑定控件、参数与数据结果。已有控件参数变化由运行时重新执行查询。
zh.caveat: 文中节省比例是场景估算；新意图仍可能调用模型，语义错误和工具权限仍需处理。
zh.audience: 开发者与技术产品人员

en.title: OpenUI moves repeat interactions into a query runtime
en.summary: The technical article demonstrates interfaces whose runtime handles filters and queries after initial generation.
en.why: Separating intent generation from interaction can reduce repeated inference and context overhead.
en.details: Reactive variables and Query declarations connect controls, parameters and results. Parameter changes rerun declared queries through the runtime.
en.caveat: Savings are scenario estimates; new intent, semantic mistakes and tool authorization still need handling.

zh.title: 社区观察：Thesys 分析 ChatGPT Intelligent UI 的运行方式
zh.summary: Thesys 根据网页版客户端与交互流量，发表对 Intelligent UI 编译和渲染机制的技术观察。
zh.why: 该观察为流式生成、状态保留和本地交互提供可研究的架构线索。
zh.details: 作者描述 DIL 格式、服务端编译以及隔离运行时与原生组件之间的操作传递。其样本来自 2026 年 10 月的网页版。
zh.caveat: 这是第三方逆向观察，不是 OpenAI 官方架构规范；移动端复用推测未直接验证，内部实现可变。
zh.audience: 开发者与架构研究者

en.title: Community observation: Thesys examines ChatGPT Intelligent UI
en.summary: Thesys analyzed web client behavior and traffic to describe Intelligent UI compilation and rendering.
en.why: The observations offer architectural leads on streaming, persistent state and local interaction.
en.details: The authors describe DIL, server compilation and operations exchanged between an isolated runtime and native components. Their observations concern October 2026 web samples.
en.caveat: This is third-party reverse engineering, not an OpenAI specification; mobile reuse was not directly verified and internals can change.

zh.title: LEGOUI 用可追溯的中间表示支持设计师干预
zh.summary: LEGOUI 将界面生成分成可解释的阶段，以 UI-DSL 保存各阶段产物和来源信息。
zh.why: 可检查的中间步骤能够帮助设计师定位偏差，而非反复试探完整提示。
zh.details: 作者使用 40 个真实设计提示评估需求分析，并开展用户研究。设计师能够介入各阶段，逐步调整生成结果。
zh.caveat: 需求分析准确率不等于完整界面正确率；研究结果依赖样本与比较工具。
zh.audience: 设计师、开发者与人机交互研究者

en.title: LEGOUI uses traceable intermediate representations for design control
en.summary: LEGOUI divides generation into interpretable stages recorded in a UI-DSL with provenance.
en.why: Inspectable intermediate steps can help designers locate mismatches instead of repeatedly rewriting prompts.
en.details: The authors evaluated requirement analysis on 40 real-world design prompts and conducted user studies. Designers can intervene and refine intermediate results.
en.caveat: Requirement-analysis accuracy is not whole-interface correctness; findings depend on samples and comparison tools.

zh.title: CopilotKit 开源 Open Intelligent UI，把即时界面生成带入自有应用
zh.summary: CopilotKit 发布 Open Intelligent UI，展示按需生成图表、地图、交互工具与三维场景的应用。项目通过 AG-UI 连接智能体。
zh.why: 它提供了可检视的实现，帮助团队探索对话中何时应出现交互界面。
zh.details: 生成的代码运行于隔离 iframe，外部库受 CDN 白名单限制。示例使用 Deep Agents，并以 OpenAI 生成回答、Jev 选择呈现形式。
zh.caveat: 这是厂商发布的开源实现，未独立验证与 ChatGPT 等效；默认示例仍需模型服务密钥。
zh.audience: 应用开发者、产品设计师

en.title: Open Intelligent UI brings on-demand interfaces to application builders
en.summary: CopilotKit released an open-source app that generates charts, maps, tools and 3D scenes through AG-UI-connected agents.
en.why: An inspectable implementation helps teams explore when conversation needs an interface.
en.details: Generated code runs in an isolated iframe with approved CDNs. The demo combines Deep Agents, OpenAI answers and Jev format selection.
en.caveat: Feature parity with ChatGPT is unverified; the default demo requires provider keys.

zh.title: Genkit Dart 1.0 发布，并展示 A2UI 原生界面流
zh.summary: Google 宣布 Genkit Dart 首个稳定版本，同时介绍通过 genkit_a2ui 向 Flutter 流式输出交互界面的路线。
zh.why: Dart 团队可把模型编排、类型化数据与原生界面放进同一技术栈。
zh.details: 核心框架提供类型化 flow、工具中断及遥测。A2UI 集成可传送日期选择器、表单和确认卡片，由 Flutter 增量渲染。
zh.caveat: 核心 1.0 稳定不代表所有高层智能体及生成式 UI API 都已稳定；文章将后者放在探索中的能力部分。
zh.audience: Flutter 开发者、智能体架构师

en.title: Genkit Dart 1.0 connects a stable core with an A2UI direction
en.summary: Google announced stable Genkit Dart 1.0 and described streaming native Flutter interfaces through genkit_a2ui.
en.why: Dart teams gain a shared stack for orchestration, typed data and UI.
en.details: Core features include typed flows, tool interrupts and telemetry. The A2UI integration streams forms, date pickers and confirmation cards.
en.caveat: Stable core status does not cover every higher-level agent or UI API discussed in the experimental direction.

zh.title: AG-UI 1.0 固化事件规范，补齐子智能体与中断语义
zh.summary: AG-UI 发布 1.0 规范及 JSON Schema，统一描述智能体与用户应用之间的事件。TypeScript、Python、.NET SDK 从同一 schema 生成。
zh.why: 稳定的交互契约使生成式界面更容易对接不同智能体后端。
zh.details: 新能力包括子智能体事件、元数据、多模态工具结果、人工中断与 token 用量。规范还明确事件顺序、运行结束及兼容处理。
zh.caveat: 协议兼容不等于 SDK 代码无需修改；迁移指南列出了校验器入口和类型变化。
zh.audience: 协议实现者、前后端开发者

en.title: AG-UI 1.0 stabilizes events for subagents and user intervention
en.summary: AG-UI published a stable specification and shared JSON Schema for its TypeScript, Python and .NET SDKs.
en.why: A common interaction contract makes UI integrations less dependent on individual agent frameworks.
en.details: Additions cover subagents, metadata, multimodal tool results, interrupts and token usage. Behavioral rules define event ordering and run completion.
en.caveat: Wire compatibility does not remove SDK migration work; imports and types changed.

zh.title: json-render 0.21 扩展到路由应用与候选界面组合
zh.summary: json-render 0.21 新增 TanStack Start 渲染器，并加入基于应用候选项的实验性 Jev 界面组合。
zh.why: 声明式 UI 开始覆盖路由、布局及服务端数据加载等应用结构。
zh.details: 新渲染器支持文件路由、共享布局和 SSR loader。版本同时改善 React 流式渲染，并为 Vue 增加命名插槽。
zh.caveat: Jev 组合 API 明确标注实验性；发行时间经 GitHub API 核验为 2026-09-18 18:53:03 UTC。
zh.audience: 前端架构师、组件平台开发者

en.title: json-render 0.21 adds application routing and candidate composition
en.summary: Version 0.21 adds a TanStack Start renderer and experimental Jev composition from app-owned candidates.
en.why: Declarative UI reaches application structure beyond individual components.
en.details: The renderer supports routes, layouts and SSR loaders. React streaming and Vue named slots also improve.
en.caveat: Composition APIs remain experimental; GitHub records publication at 2026-09-18 18:53:03 UTC.
en.audience: Frontend architects and component platform developers

zh.title: CopilotKit 让前端工具可被 WebMCP 浏览器智能体发现
zh.summary: CopilotKit 增加 WebMCP 支持，可按工具启用浏览器智能体访问既有 useFrontendTool 能力。
zh.why: 同一应用操作可被内嵌助手与外部浏览器智能体复用。
zh.details: 工具随组件挂载注册、卸载移除，并携带调用注解。服务端渲染及不支持的环境采用回退处理。
zh.caveat: 这是相邻的交互基础设施，并非新的 UI 生成模型；可用性取决于浏览器支持和工具授权。
zh.audience: 前端开发者、浏览器智能体开发者

en.title: CopilotKit exposes frontend tools through WebMCP
en.summary: CopilotKit added per-tool WebMCP support so browser agents can discover existing frontend actions.
en.why: Embedded assistants and browser agents can reuse application operations.
en.details: Tools register with component lifecycle and carry annotations. Unsupported and server-rendered environments fall back gracefully.
en.caveat: This is adjacent interaction infrastructure, not a UI generation model; browser support and authorization still matter.

zh.title: CopilotKit 将 AG-UI 交互带入 React Native 原生组件
zh.summary: CopilotKit 展示 React Native SDK，把 AG-UI 智能体接入 iOS 和 Android，并在聊天中渲染原生组件。
zh.why: 生成式交互可复用后端，同时适应移动端的组件与设备能力。
zh.details: useRenderTool 将工具结果映射到 React 元素；前端工具在设备端执行。运行时由应用方托管，模型密钥保留在服务器。
zh.caveat: 文中 A2UI 属于后续方向，不能据此宣称原生 A2UI 已完整发布；语音需自行集成。
zh.audience: 移动开发者、跨端产品团队

en.title: CopilotKit brings AG-UI to native React Native components
en.summary: The React Native SDK connects AG-UI agents to iOS and Android interfaces using native components.
en.why: Teams can reuse agent backends while adapting interaction to devices.
en.details: useRenderTool maps tool calls to React elements, while frontend handlers run on-device. A self-hosted runtime keeps model keys server-side.
en.caveat: A2UI is described as a future direction; voice remains bring-your-own.
en.audience: Mobile developers and cross-platform product teams

zh.title: json-render 0.20 增加命名插槽与嵌套数据重复渲染
zh.summary: json-render 0.20 为 React 增加命名插槽，并让多个渲染目标支持基于当前条目的嵌套重复结构。
zh.why: 组件目录能表达更复杂的布局和层级数据，减少生成界面的特殊分支。
zh.details: header、footer 等插槽贯穿校验、流式处理与导出流程。版本修复链式动作参数，并新增 AI SDK harness 聊天示例。
zh.caveat: 自定义 executeAction 桥接需改接 ActionBinding；GitHub 记录发布时间为 2026-08-18 18:23:29 UTC。
zh.audience: 组件库维护者、生成式 UI 开发者

en.title: json-render 0.20 expands slots and nested data rendering
en.summary: Version 0.20 adds React named slots and item-relative nested repeats across renderers.
en.why: Component catalogs can express richer layouts and hierarchical data.
en.details: Slots survive validation, streaming and export. The release fixes chained action parameters and adds an AI SDK harness example.
en.caveat: Custom executeAction bridges must accept ActionBinding; publication was 2026-08-18 18:23:29 UTC.
en.audience: Component-library maintainers and generative UI developers

zh.title: Channels SDK 将 AG-UI 智能体界面扩展到 Slack 与 Teams
zh.summary: CopilotKit 发布 Channels SDK，用统一代码把智能体及交互消息带到 Slack、Microsoft Teams。
zh.why: 生成式 UI 的呈现表面从独立网页延伸到团队日常沟通工具。
zh.details: 同一 JSX 消息可映射为 Slack Block Kit 或 Teams Adaptive Cards。交互支持工具、人工审批及会话状态。
zh.caveat: SDK 开源不意味着托管通道永久免费；发布方案依赖 CopilotKit Intelligence，生产持久化需配置存储。
zh.audience: 企业应用团队、协作工具开发者

en.title: Channels SDK carries AG-UI experiences into Slack and Teams
en.summary: CopilotKit released a shared SDK for agents and interactive messages across Slack and Microsoft Teams.
en.why: Generative interfaces can reach existing collaboration surfaces.
en.details: JSX messages map to Block Kit or Adaptive Cards. Tools, approvals and conversation state accompany the UI.
en.caveat: The managed channel path depends on CopilotKit Intelligence; production persistence needs storage. Open source does not imply free hosting.

zh.title: CopilotKit 发布 Angular 集成，连接受控组件与开放生成界面
zh.summary: CopilotKit 宣布由 Soverius AI 在主仓库维护 Angular 绑定，提供聊天、共享状态和多种生成式 UI 路径。
zh.why: 采用 Angular 的团队可在既有应用中探索智能体界面。
zh.details: 工具调用可渲染 Angular 组件，也可使用 A2UI 表面或隔离 iframe。MacroQuest 示例通过 NgRx Signal Store 保持可信状态。
zh.caveat: 公告时支持 Angular 19–21，22 仍在后续计划；本条记录发布时范围。
zh.audience: Angular 开发者、企业前端团队

en.title: CopilotKit adds Angular paths for controlled and open UI
en.summary: CopilotKit announced upstream Angular bindings maintained by Soverius AI, including chat and shared state.
en.why: Angular teams can integrate agent interfaces into existing applications.
en.details: Tool calls render Angular components, A2UI surfaces or sandboxed UI. The MacroQuest example keeps trusted data in NgRx Signal Store.
en.caveat: The announcement supports Angular 19–21, with 22 planned; this records launch scope.
en.audience: Angular developers and enterprise frontend teams

zh.title: Google 与 MCP Apps 共创者给出三种界面互操作模式
zh.summary: 官方文章展示 A2UI 经 MCP 传输、A2UI 内嵌 MCP App，以及 MCP App 内运行 A2UI 渲染器三种组合。
zh.why: 原生组件的一致性与自定义网页的灵活性可以按场景组合。
zh.details: 示例以 application/a2ui+json 传递声明式界面。复杂模块可运行于 iframe，并通过事件同步关键状态。
zh.caveat: 这是架构模式与示例发布；文章称专门 MCP 扩展仍在考虑，不能写成已经统一的正式标准。
zh.audience: 平台架构师、MCP 应用开发者

en.title: A2UI and MCP Apps document three interoperability patterns
en.summary: Google and MCP Apps co-creators show A2UI over MCP, MCP Apps inside A2UI, and A2UI inside MCP Apps.
en.why: Teams can combine native consistency with custom web interactions.
en.details: Examples use application/a2ui+json for declarative payloads. Embedded apps synchronize key state through events.
en.caveat: These are patterns and samples; a dedicated MCP extension was still under consideration.
en.audience: Platform architects and MCP application developers

zh.title: Flutter 公布 GenUI 0.9 迁移指南，拆分渲染与模型连接
zh.summary: Flutter 官方解释 GenUI 0.9 如何采用 A2UI 0.9，并从结构化输出优先转向提示词驱动的消息生成。
zh.why: 模型连接、重试与界面状态分离后，应用可以独立测试和替换各层。
zh.details: ContentGenerator 被移除，职责拆为 SurfaceController、A2uiTransportAdapter 与 Conversation。PromptBuilder 帮助构造目录与协议提示词。
zh.caveat: 5 月 14 日是指南发表日，不是经核验的软件首次发行日；升级包含破坏性 API 变化。
zh.audience: Flutter 开发者、跨端架构师

en.title: Flutter explains GenUI 0.9 migration and transport separation
en.summary: Flutter published guidance on GenUI 0.9, adopting A2UI 0.9 and prompt-driven message generation.
en.why: Separating rendering and model connections supports replacement and isolated testing.
en.details: SurfaceController, A2uiTransportAdapter and Conversation replace ContentGenerator responsibilities. PromptBuilder supplies catalog and protocol instructions.
en.caveat: May 14 is the guide publication date, not a verified first package release date; migration is breaking.

zh.title: A2UI 0.9 加强组件目录、双向同步与多框架渲染
zh.summary: Google 发布 A2UI 0.9，增加共享 web-core、官方 React 渲染器与 Agent SDK，继续把 UI 意图与实现分离。
zh.why: 开发者可用已有设计系统承接智能体输出，降低对单一前端框架的依赖。
zh.details: 协议增加客户端函数、客户端到服务端的数据同步及模块化 schema。Agent SDK 支持版本协商、动态目录和增量流解析。
zh.caveat: 跨框架支持仍需客户端实现和应用适配；公告中的生态案例不是独立的安全或性能证明。
zh.audience: 设计系统团队、协议与应用开发者

en.title: A2UI 0.9 strengthens catalogs, synchronization and rendering
en.summary: Google released A2UI 0.9 with shared web-core, an official React renderer and an Agent SDK.
en.why: Existing design systems can render agent intent across frontend frameworks.
en.details: The update adds client functions, data synchronization and modular schemas. The SDK handles version negotiation, catalogs and incremental parsing.
en.caveat: Cross-framework support still needs client integration; examples are not independent security or performance validation.

zh.title: MCP Apps 成为正式扩展，让工具返回交互界面
zh.summary: MCP 维护者宣布 MCP Apps 正式上线，为工具提供在对话内展示表单、图表和工作流的标准连接方式。
zh.why: 工具结果不必只靠文字转述，用户可以直接操作数据和界面。
zh.details: 工具通过 UI 元数据引用 ui:// 资源，宿主在沙箱 iframe 中呈现。界面与宿主使用基于 postMessage 的 JSON-RPC 双向通信。
zh.caveat: 需要支持该扩展的宿主；可交互界面既可能预先编写，也可能动态生成，不能一概视为模型生成代码。
zh.audience: MCP 服务开发者、对话产品团队

en.title: MCP Apps formalizes interactive tool interfaces
en.summary: MCP maintainers launched an official extension for forms, visualizations and workflows inside conversations.
en.why: Users can manipulate tool results directly instead of requesting every change in text.
en.details: Tool metadata references ui:// resources rendered in sandboxed iframes. JSON-RPC over postMessage connects the interface and host.
en.caveat: Host support is required; interactive apps can be pre-authored rather than model-generated.
en.audience: MCP server developers and conversational product teams
